evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state after processing a drop track message — specifically that non-C2 JUs act on it for locally held remote tracks, which is part of the postcondition landscape for track termination scenarios involving remote entities.

evidence_cards.content: Additionally, nonC² JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks, after a specified time interval, when these tracks are no longer being updated. The time interval is a system selected parameter.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an optional but valid postcondition state: automatic purging of stale remote tracks by non-C2 JUs after a configurable timeout — directly relevant to the ‘Terminate and Purge Surveillance Tracks’ use case’s success boundary when applied to remote track contexts.

evidence_cards.content: After successful termination via J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report transmission, the JU with R² specified in the Source TN field has dropped or ceased reporting the track specified in the Reference TN field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state after successful track termination: cessation of reporting for the specified track by the responsible JU.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU receives a Surveillance message or J7.0 (ACT = 1) message indicating an Environment/Category conflict, that conflict shall be processed and resolved prior to ID conflict resolution; if an Environment/Category conflict is detected, no further processing to detect an ID conflict need occur.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies post-resolution behavior during difference report handling — implies that upon successful resolution of Environment/Category conflicts, ID conflict detection may be skipped, defining a terminal state for that branch of processing.
